reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text (p0001) supports the rationale: the only 'access' obligation on Customer is a cooperation covenant to enable Kubient to deliver the Services, not an audit, inspection or usage-verification right, and no audit/records/inspection language appears elsewhere in the Agreement.
Absence of any audit right binding Customer is at least as favourable as the preferred position (annual, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor cost, no system access), so no edit is warranted.

The failed deterministic check ('audit frequency limited') is an artefact of there being no audit clause to constrain, not evidence of a deviation; the finding correctly flags that any future Kubient-proposed audit clause should be held to the preferred parameters.
